lines: Some bike problems show only in the bytes. Now Diagnostics keeps a packet log, on this device.
By default it keeps the commands sent to the bike: every resistance change and keepalive, counted in commands and kilobytes.
Turn on Log every packet while you reproduce a problem, and the bike's messages are kept too, with a Recording tag.
Download packet log saves a JSON Lines file for the day: one object per message, with its time, direction, frame type and bytes.
Two acceptance tests failed first and pass now. The log holds ten megabytes at most, and errors reach only the console, with no email or token.
The packet log, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
